clue.text: Policeman arrests hard old criminal, a lout

indicators.note: a policeman who arrests someone holds them, so the officer's word grips the other letters

parts.note: copper is everyday slang for a police officer

indicators.note: criminal suggests something bent or crooked, so these letters are twisted into a new order

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A police officer collars a hardened old offender who is a thug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' looks like a noun for the old lag but is the anagram signal, making LODH; copper is British slang for a policeman.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy, boorish oaf is a lout, the sort of person called heavy-footed and loutish.

clue.text: Chuckling subsequently to mask expression of disgust

indicators.note: a mask covers a face, so the word for later wraps around and covers the other piece

parts.note: subsequently means later, afterwards
ugh is the interjection of revulsion

explanation.surface: Someone stifles a giggle with a grimace of disgust a moment later.
explanation.definitionFit: Chuckling is quiet laughing, so the noun for the sound of mirth fits as a gerund synonym.

clue.text: Give out something needed for board game?

definitions.meaning: to expire or stop working, as a phone battery or an engine does
a single dice cube, rolled in games such as ludo

explanation.surface: A request to hand out a piece needed for a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one spelling: the verb meaning to stop working and the singular of the cube thrown in games.

clue.text: Outside gents there may be extra-large signs

indicators.note: outside places the clothing-size letters around the lavatory word

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize
men's, as in the gents' lavatory

explanation.surface: Large notices may hang outside a public lavatory.
explanation.definitionFit: Omens are portents, signs of what is to come.

clue.text: Italian city's less healthy-looking state

parts.note: paler means more pallid, less rosy and healthy
MO is the abbreviation for Missouri, a US state

explanation.surface: An Italian city is said to look a sicker shade than it once did.
explanation.definitionFit: Palermo is the capital of Sicily, a city in Italy.

clue.text: Like a barrage of questions, worse if parried

indicators.note: worse suggests something knocked out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A volley of questions may go badly if they are fended off.
explanation.definitionFit: Questions asked in quick succession are said to come rapid-fire, like shots from a gun.

clue.text: Instrument cutting nasty woman short

indicators.note: short means the word is cut back by its final letter

parts.note: a harpy is a shrewish, grasping woman

explanation.surface: A musical instrument is used to cut down a spiteful woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' is only a link here; 'short' trims the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A harp is a stringed musical instrument plucked with the fingers.

clue.text: Aggressive approach by cricketer makes one condemnatory

definitions.meaning: a batsman striking the ball forcefully is said to be doing this
severely critical, as a scathing report is

explanation.surface: A batsman's attacking style makes him severely critical.
explanation.definitionFit: The same compound describes forceful batting and a report or review that criticises without mercy.

clue.text: Revolt when there's something wrong in apparatus

indicators.note: in places the wrongdoing inside the word for equipment

parts.note: a rig is a piece of equipment or apparatus
a sin is a wrongdoing

explanation.surface: An uprising happens when a machine develops a fault.
explanation.definitionFit: A rising is an uprising, a revolt against authority.

clue.text: Gloomy female pretended to swallow drug

indicators.note: swallowing takes something in, so the drug letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: unreal means imaginary, make-believe
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A melancholy woman faked taking a pill.
explanation.definitionFit: Funereal means suited to a funeral, hence sombre and gloomy.

clue.text: Sequence of words that may be heard in quarrels

indicators.note: heard means the word is spoken and recognised by its sound

parts.note: frays are brawls or quarrels

explanation.surface: A string of words might be overheard during arguments.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase is a small group of words forming a unit of sense.

clue.text: Island thoroughfares given a mention

indicators.note: mentioning something means saying it out loud, so the word is spoken

parts.note: roads are thoroughfares

explanation.surface: An island's streets are referred to in passing.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhodes is a Greek island in the Aegean Sea.

clue.text: Argy-bargy right in the middle of club function

indicators.note: the letter for right is placed inside the event

parts.note: a disco dance is an event at a nightclub or social club

explanation.surface: A squabble breaks out at the centre of a club party.
explanation.walkthrough: Argy-bargy is British slang for noisy quarrelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Argy-bargy, a heated quarrel, is a form of disagreement or strife.

clue.text: Hen's dark — unusually so for a bird

indicators.note: unusually means arranged in an uncommon way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hen is unusually dark for a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hen' suggests the bird is a fowl; it is fodder, with the S of 'Hen's' kept.
explanation.definitionFit: The redshank is a wading bird with red legs.

clue.text: Missile got so off course, one could sense the shock waves

definitions.text: one could sense the shock waves

indicators.note: a missile off course is deflected, so the letters are deflected into a new order

explanation.surface: A missile strays so far that someone detects the blast.
explanation.definitionFit: A scientist who studies earthquakes measures their tremors with seismographs.

clue.text: Where face cream may be applied there and then

definitions.text: Where face cream may be applied
definitions.meaning: on a pimple or blemish, where ointment is dabbed

explanation.surface: Ointment is dabbed onto a blemish immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means immediately, and literally it is on a pimple where cream goes.

clue.text: Loveless god taken to be menace

indicators.note: love is O in tennis scoring, so loveless means that letter is removed

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
eaten, as food taken or consumed

explanation.surface: A god without love is regarded as a danger.
explanation.definitionFit: To menace is to threaten, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Football player dismissed by team justly

parts.note: a batsman dismissed in cricket is out
a side is a team
right as an adverb, meaning fairly or correctly

explanation.surface: A footballer is fairly sent off by his club.
explanation.definitionFit: In old football formations the outside right played on the right wing.

clue.text: Coming transformation of Tories with new input

indicators.note: input means something put in, so the letter for new is put inside
a transformation changes the shape, so the letters of the party word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Conservative party is due a makeover with fresh contributions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transformation of' rearranges TORIES into ISTORE; 'input' puts N after the I.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in store is coming, waiting to happen in the future.

clue.text: Tree beginning to collapse when cut

indicators.note: the beginning of the word collapse is its first letter

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
to hew is to cut with an axe

explanation.surface: A tree starts to fall as it is chopped down.
explanation.definitionFit: The cashew is a tropical tree that bears the kidney-shaped nut.

clue.text: Prison officer in military uniform?

definitions.meaning: a female warder in a jail
read as two words, clothing worn for battle

explanation.surface: A jailer turns up in army clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A wardress is a woman guard in a prison; split, it whimsically means battle clothing.

clue.text: Worked for prefect, becoming tired

definitions.meaning: at British public schools a junior boy did chores for a senior one

explanation.surface: A pupil grows weary after serving a senior boy.
explanation.walkthrough: Fagging was the British boarding-school custom of junior boys serving prefects.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both served an older pupil at school and, colloquially, worn out.

clue.text: Bodily appetites of Henry with ego in the ascendant

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word reads upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the ego is the self
H is the symbol for henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: King Henry's self-regard is on the rise.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'in the ascendant' means read upwards, giving FLES; 'Henry' is not the king but the unit of inductance.
explanation.definitionFit: The flesh means physical, sensual desires, as opposed to the spirit.

clue.text: Foreign character takes joke the wrong way? Keep smiling!

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: the wrong way means the word for a joke is read backwards

parts.note: a pun is a wordplay joke

explanation.surface: Someone from abroad misreads a quip, and is told to cheer up.
explanation.definitionFit: Chin up is an encouraging phrase urging someone to stay cheerful.

clue.text: Light work to get a treetop reshaped

indicators.note: reshaped means given a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Pruning a tree's crown is an easy task.
explanation.definitionFit: An operetta is a light opera, a musical work of a lighter kind.

clue.text: Measure skilfully concealed initially

indicators.note: the first letter is hidden away, so it is dropped

parts.note: well means skilfully, as in 'played well'

explanation.surface: A measurement is cleverly hidden at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: An ell is an old unit of length for cloth, about 45 inches.

clue.text: Sickly material brought to a premature end

indicators.note: ended early, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: tweed is a woollen cloth

explanation.surface: Sickly fabric has its run cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: Twee means cloyingly sweet or quaint, sickly in sentiment.

clue.text: Conform to expectations when the heat is on? (3,3,4) 23,230

definitions.meaning: to obey the rules and behave as required
runners line up at the start of a race heat with their feet at the mark

explanation.surface: Fall into line when under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means comply with rules, from runners setting their feet at the start mark.
